run_fp16_safetensors_conversion: run the diffusers CLI fp16_safetensors command to convert a checkpoint repo to FP16 and safetensors format
create_fp16_safetensors_command: create an FP16SafetensorsCommand instance with a checkpoint repo ID, fp16 flag, and safetensors flag
register_fp16_safetensors_subcommand: register the fp16_safetensors subcommand with argparse to accept ckpt_id, fp16, and use_safetensors arguments
convert_checkpoint_to_fp16: convert a HuggingFace model checkpoint to FP16 precision and upload via a pull request
convert_checkpoint_to_safetensors: convert a HuggingFace model checkpoint to safetensors format and upload via a pull request
